home.stagesTitle: How Flow-Cortex Handles Your Video Runs

source.title: Source
source.body: Submit a link or upload a media file. Required fields and limits are checked up front.

process.title: Process
process.body: Workers run each step in order. Status, attempts and errors are saved on every node.

review.title: Review
review.body: Pauses at the review gates you configured. Edit content, then approve to continue.

export.title: Export
export.body: Download the finished output while it is still within the asset retention window.

docs.title: How FlowCortex works
docs.subtitle: Concept guides, walk-throughs and the full HTTP API for the workflows you build.

overview.body: FlowCortex is a runtime for AI workflows: a chain of typed steps that can call a model, wait for a human to approve, render a video, or post to a social account. Every workflow is a graph; every run is a journey through that graph.

api.intro: The HTTP API is the same surface the Member and Admin apps use. Tokens come from POST /api/v1/auth/login and are sent as Authorization: Bearer … on every request.
api.listWorkflows: — list the workflows you can run.
api.readRun: — read the current state of a run.
api.listReviewTasks: — list the approval checkpoints still open.
api.schemaHint: The full schema is published as docs/openapi.yaml and generated into the API client at packages/api-client. Use the generated types in your own app code.

guides.firstRun: Run your first pipeline. Open Home, pick a template, send the input and watch the run update step by step.
guides.approveOnRuns: Approve a step. When a run hits an approval checkpoint, it stays Waiting for review on the Runs page until you act.
guides.approveOnRun: Approve a step. When a run hits an approval checkpoint, it stays Waiting for review on the run page until you act.
guides.byoProvider: Bring your own AI provider. Add a key on the Integrations page; any workflow that needs that model will pick it up automatically.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Bring the AI providers and social accounts your workflows depend on. Keys stay on your account and are reused across every run.
